texto:
Walking is a simple and effective exercise that many people can enjoy. Unlike going to the gym, you do not need any special equipment or a membership. All you need is a comfortable pair of shoes. You can walk in a local park, in your neighborhood, or even on a treadmill at home. It is an easy way to add more physical activity to your daily life.

The benefits of walking are numerous. For your physical health, it helps keep your heart strong and improves blood circulation. It also strengthens your leg muscles. But walking is not just for the body; it is also good for your mind. A regular walking routine can reduce stress and improve your mood. Many people find that a walk helps them think more clearly and feel calmer.

To start, you don't need to walk for hours. Even 30 minutes a day can make a big difference. You can try walking to the store instead of driving or taking a short walk after dinner. The most important thing is to be consistent.

preguntas.pregunta: According to the text, what do you need to start walking for exercise?
preguntas.explicacion: La respuesta correcta es C porque el texto dice explícitamente qué se necesita para empezar a caminar: 'All you need is a comfortable pair of shoes'. The text clearly states this is the only requirement. Las otras opciones son incorrectas. A y B son incorrectas porque el texto dice 'you do not need any special equipment or a membership'. La opción D no se menciona en absoluto. La E es mencionada como un lugar donde se puede caminar ('on a treadmill at home'), pero no como un requisito necesario.

preguntas.pregunta: From the text, we can infer that walking is a good exercise for people who...

opciones.B: do not have much time or money.

preguntas.explicacion: La respuesta correcta es B. Podemos inferir esto porque el texto destaca que caminar no es caro y no requiere mucho tiempo. Dice 'you do not need any special equipment or a membership', lo que implica un bajo costo, y también 'Even 30 minutes a day can make a big difference', lo que sugiere que no se necesita mucho tiempo. The other options are incorrect. La opción A es improbable, ya que el texto describe caminar como un ejercicio 'simple'. La C es falsa porque el texto menciona beneficios para la mente ('good for your mind'). La D es incorrecta porque se puede caminar en otros lugares ('in your neighborhood'). La E es improbable, ya que el ejercicio se presenta como accesible para 'many people', no solo para atletas.
